data.name: Sharvee
data.long_meaning: The name Sharvee is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Shree’, which means prosperity, wealth and good fortune. The suffix ‘Vee’ in Sharvee signifies the goddess of love, Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, arts, wisdom and learning. Thus, Sharvee is a beautiful name that embodies love, grace and prosperity.
